limits: Only all four fresh count-v1 arms; original v6 958/2 failed quality remains failed, excluded rather than relabelled or spliced.
Descriptive post-collection aggregation, not a preregistered new adoption gate, inference or significance test. Two arms per renderer; 1920 snapshots are correlated, not independent repetitions.
Nearest-rank p50/p95. Each renderer latency pools its two original 30-sample formal vectors; warmups excluded. Memory pools genuine capture snapshots, not fixed240s/equal-time weighted means.
CPU normalizes summed disjoint counter deltas by summed read-window midpoint intervals; intervals exclude settle, warmups and final tail.
Cold-start/first-interactive-frame/search-ready/GPU/wakeup/IME/DPI/multimonitor and whole-host idle remain unverified. Context-switch counts are not wakeups.
These Linux controlled native-visible/foreground proxies do not prove Windows performance, production adoption eligibility or Phase6/Phase7 acceptance.
